capabilities: Convert notes into tweets and Twitter threads
Purchase a license to skip API key setup
extras: The plugin offers a paid license so users don't have to set up OpenAI and Twitter API keys themselves, because these API costs are not affordable for the author to cover for everyone. A demo section exists but its content was removed in this README.
motivation: The author was struggling to share learnings and wanted to do it automagically: "I was struggling with this myself and wanted to share all my learnings with the world automagically, so I built this."
problem: Writing a lot but lacking the time or motivation to also write and schedule tweets to share those notes with the world.
summary: AI-assisted tweet generator that turns your notes into tweets and Twitter threads, then schedules them via the Twitter API.
